content.content: When invoked as `deccy show <id>` with valid ids, the deccy CLI shall write one output per valid node — the stored node document — to stdout as pretty JSON verbatim.
content.rationale: Agents and pipes need the exact document the graph holds; fixed field lines would re-decide presentation and summary lines would lose fidelity. Pretty JSON round-trips the stored file under O5's line discipline. States only the rendering fact without re-deciding D16a's lookup steps, O4's status rule, or O5's channel rules.
